inputs.fontInventoryGap: No script, italic, display, condensed Latin or decorative face is pinned. The serif-plus-script and minimal-italic directions in the owner's references cannot be reproduced with repository fonts.

coverage.method: research/editorial-typography-proof/cmap-probe.ts reads cmap formats 4/12; Unicode coverage only, not shaping
coverage.result: Only Noto Sans Thai covers all proof copy. Source Serif 4, Plex Sans and Plex Mono miss every Thai code point in the copy (for example U+0E25, U+0E38, U+0E04 in '3 ลุค · OLIVE GREEN').
coverage.sourceCheck: No file under packages/*/src parses cmap; the documented exact-copy coverage gap still holds in this checkout.

renderTiming: Each 1080x1920, 168-frame treatment rendered in about 18 s wall time on this machine (single worker, canvas2d).
reviewFrames: entrance 16/24/32, hold 60/100, exit 130/138/146 via FFmpeg frame ordinal; phone sheets at 360x640 per frame; native crops for detail. Committed JPEGs: docs/review/editorial-typography-proof-2026-11-15/

observations.title: Attach constraints use line-box bounds widened by animation excursions
observations.evidence: Hold frame 60, headline ink 827-1013 px in all T1 renders. Authored gaps kicker 18 px / folio 30 px. Static control: 95 / 109 px (line box: font ascent/descent, not ink or cap height). Animated pass 1: 153 / 213 px (kicker -58 px, folio +104 px more). Folio landed on the stone bench.
observations.workaround: Pass 2 uses hand coordinates measured from rendered ink; these do not adapt to other copy.
observations.source: packages/renderer-core/src/composition/evaluate/constraints.ts pointInLayer uses rectangle(state) bounds; constraintReference is absolute layer-space, not normalized to the target's own bounds.

observations.classification: observed defect, not caught by validation or render
observations.title: Centred text centres on the layer origin, not inside textLayout width
observations.evidence: T3 pass 1 placed align:center lines at x=70 with a 940 px textLayout; half of both lines rendered off-frame. comp validate: valid. comp render: rendered, no warnings. Measured-bounds lint (video removed): outside-safe-area warning only, same severity as a few-pixel incursion; no off-canvas finding.
observations.note: May be intended semantics ('text draws at the layer origin'); either way it is an unguarded authoring trap.

observations.title: Highlight decoration ignores text-animator opacity
observations.evidence: T2 pass 1 exit faded the tag's glyphs; the pale highlight bar stayed fully visible from about frame 130 to the out point. Pass 2 retracts it with explicit reveal keys.

observations.title: comp lint --pixels true fails on compositions with a native video layer
observations.evidence: 6/6 runs (three treatments, pass 1 and pass 2) report invalid-scene 'page.evaluate: Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation'. The same compositions with only the video layer and asset removed lint successfully with pixels and measured text bounds; examples/composition/05-pinned-text.ts also lints with pixels.
observations.hypothesis: packages/animation-engine/src/composition-lint.ts inlines every resolved asset path as a base64 data URL into one page.evaluate payload and serves the renderer through a Vite dev page; prepared video frames may overload or trigger a page reload. Unconfirmed.
observations.consequence: No current check measures text over actual video pixels.

observations.title: Missing glyphs silently fall back outside the pinned font
observations.evidence: coverage-negative: '3 ลุค · OLIVE GREEN' in pinned Plex Sans renders Thai glyphs from a face outside the composition, with only Plex loaded. validate: valid; render: rendered; warnings []; systemFontLayers []. Identity of the fallback face unmeasured.

observations.title: Composition lint has no text-contrast rule
observations.evidence: Rules are frozen-run, frozen-pixels, velocity-discontinuity, easing-monotony, co-start, reading-time, off-canvas, outside-safe-area, coverage, scale-pop, opacity-pop. text-contrast exists only in packages/renderer-core/src/typography-quality.ts for story specimens. T3 pass 2's credit '· 03' crosses the dark roof edge and the rule crosses a roof line under parallax; nothing reports it.

observations.classification: policy conflict, not a renderer defect
observations.title: Default reading-time conflicts with continuous hold motion
observations.evidence: Every treatment with a gentle hold drift (tracking +25/+30 or 14 px rise over 80 frames) fails reading-time with 0.00-0.13 s readable time. The owner's standing preference is continuous meaningful motion; the policy's displacement budget is configurable but no editorial-title profile exists.

observations.title: State lint treats footage-only spans as frozen
observations.evidence: After the titles leave (frames 157-167) state lint reports frozen-run although the clip is moving; pixel mode would measure it but fails with video (O4).

observations.title: State lint cannot evaluate attach constraints on text
observations.evidence: T1 pass 1 state lint stops with comp-text-layout-missing 'Text constraints need measured layer bounds'; it produces no motion findings.

observations.title: Axis range validation is more conservative than the timeline
observations.evidence: T2 with entrance wght -800, hold to wght -120 and exit to wght -680 failed comp-text-font-axis reporting a -20 worst case; my frame analysis gives 100 as the true minimum. Without the hold delta, entrance -800 plus exit -680 validates. Pass 2 dropped the hold axis change.

observations.title: Detached serif fragment during masked per-glyph entrance
observations.evidence: T1 frames 30-36 in both passes show a small square fragment beside the 'v' right serif while 'e' rises through the line mask; settled frames are clean.

observations.classification: observed pass for this copy only
observations.title: Thai mark cohesion and variable-axis animation
observations.evidence: Per-glyph entrance/exit of 'สามลุค' keeps U+0E38 with its base consonant in inspected frames 24-40 and 128-140; wght/wdth animation from 100/100 to 900/62.5 renders. One word, one font, canvas2d only; does not validate finer Thai units or other copy.

pass2.t3: state: reading-time, frozen-run, outside-safe-area (clip); pixels: invalid-scene; no-clip pixels: reading-time; the text safe-area warning is gone
